items.title: Ann Widdecombe, former Tory minister and Reform UK member, dies aged 78
items.summary: Prominent Eurosceptic and social conservative described as ‘force of nature’ by Farage and ‘formidable’ by Badenoch Anne Widdecombe – obituary The former Conservative minister Ann Widdecombe has died aged 78, her management has said. Widdecombe, who served as an MP and an MEP during a lengthy and often controversial political career, gained notoriety as a television personality in later life. Besides the Tories, she was also a member of the Brexit party and its successor, Reform UK. Continue reading...
